name: @aethelred/wallet-paymaster-sponsor
description: Paymaster-sponsor service for ERC-4337 UserOperations. Agents pay gas in USDC; the sponsor prices the gas, evaluates policy (reputation / VC / rate limits), and signs a VerifyingPaymaster-compatible approval. Holds no user funds — the paymaster contract settles both sides atomically on-chain. Self-hostable by anyone: merchant, agent operator, or neutral third party.
